verdict: Leads are arriving at a lower cost, but pipeline conversion needs attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta campaign delivered 37 leads at an average cost per lead of $40.69, all from a single active campaign. Encouragingly, cost per lead dropped sharply in the most recent active days — a genuine efficiency gain — though ad spend went dark for five consecutive days mid-period, which suppressed overall volume. None of the 37 platform-reported leads have converted into pipeline opportunities in your CRM, which points to an intake gap rather than an ads issue, and that is the primary focus right now. Pending CRM automation and lead-routing work due this month is being accelerated to close that gap before it costs you further cases.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period from paid ads
average cost per lead this period, down sharply in the final active days
actions taken on your Google Business Profile this period — calls, website clicks, and more

watch_item.issue: 37 leads arrived this period but none have progressed to a pipeline opportunity in the CRM, signaling an intake gap between ad response and case intake.
watch_item.fix: CRM lead-routing, automated follow-up, and case-logging are being completed this month to ensure no inbound lead goes unworked.
